=====================
Gitignore File Format
=====================

Simple example
==============

.. code:: gitignore

   #:gigi:version 0.3.0
   #:gigi:arguments: Nim
   # This file is generated by gigi.
   # Lines under "#:gigi:source:" are overwritten by rebuild.
   # Write your own rules under "#:gigi:user:".

   #:gigi:source: github/Nim
   nimcache/
   nimblecache/
   htmldocs/

   #:gigi:user
